description: Returns Futuur's latest currency exchange rates. Each entry is a base currency (USD, EUR, BTC, USDC, USDT) with `rates`: how many units of every quoted currency (BCH, BNB, BRL, BTC, ETH, EUR, LTC, MXN, SOL, TRX, USD, XMR, BUSD, DOGE, USDC, USDT) one unit of the base is worth, and the time of the last update. Play money (OOM) has no rate. Pass `base_currency` to get one base only; use convert_to_usd or convert_from_usd to convert an amount.

base_currency.description: Return only this base currency's rates: USD, EUR, BTC, USDC or USDT (case-insensitive). Omit for all bases.

name: get_exchange_rates
title: Get exchange rates
